gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).

gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
